summary.text: Anastassiya Andrianova is the Democratic candidate for the North Dakota House of Representatives, District 11, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 9, 2026 Democratic primary.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as an educator of more than twenty years and said public education, North Dakota families and the environment are her priorities.

paragraphs.text: Andrianova said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is the mother of a second grader and an educator of more than twenty years.
She said she was born in Kyiv, Ukraine, is a naturalized U.S. citizen, and hopes to become the first Ukrainian American to serve in the North Dakota Legislature.
Andrianova said her top priority is public education, including addressing the K-12 teacher shortage through well-paid, highly trained teachers and universal free school meals.
She also listed affordable childcare, paid parental leave and lower healthcare premiums and out-of-pocket costs as priorities, along with growing wind and solar energy capacity.
According to her survey response, her endorsers include the North Dakota Democratic-NPL, Cass County Dems United and the North Dakota AFL-CIO.
